visual_review.notes: Reviewed all 992 chronological original frames, enlarged grips/anatomy/alpha, gait loop and attack joins, all selected native-size phases and three candidate battle renders. Reciprocal gait, hooked-knife anticipation/contact/recovery, recoil, held shield brace, physical support and grounded collapse are coherent.
